text:
marta: Quick handover — I'm off at 19:30 UTC. Leaving a few things for overnight. TL;DR: canary kv-eviction experiment still on (degraded on host-3), staging-ingest retried twice (CI plugin timeout suspected), dedicated-gpu pool has ~12% spare capacity under current batch load. I'll leave check steps below.

alex: taking overnight, thanks. where's the canary dashboard?

marta: https://dash.internal/redwood/canaries/kv-evict — host-3 shows 5% higher tail-latency. If it climbs >20ms, rollback to v1.2.1 (see runbook).

alex: got it. I'll watch tail and set alert if rising.

devbot: [infra-bot] Canary rollout: kv-evict v1.2.2 -> 3/5 hosts healthy, 1 degraded on host-3, 1 pending. Related alert suppressed due to canary-mode.

priya: FYI: staging-ingest failures tracked in INC-4123, temporary workaround is increasing worker timeout to 45s in config: `STAGING_WORKER_TIMEOUT=45` — I pushed a patch to staging, monitor queue length.

alex: noted, will keep an eye on queue. If backlog > 2k, scale staging-workers +1 using `./scripts/scale staging +1`.

marta: action items: 1) alex monitor canary & rollback if latency >20ms; 2) priya follow up with CI team on plugin timeout tomorrow; 3) sam to review dedicated GPU preemption rules (low headroom). Leaving quick-checks below.

```
# check canary logs
kubectl logs -l app=kv-canary -n infra --tail=200
# watch staging queue
redis-cli -n 3 LLEN staging:ingest:queue
```

sam: on it, I'll take a look at preemption rules and comment in the ticket.

alex: taking responsibility. I'll ping in the morning with status. :thumbsup: 

marta: thanks — no expected urgent pages. If anything noisy, page the oncall channel and DM me if it's >P1.

devbot: [reminder] Next scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC — expect transient ~30s connection blips.
